name: IconButton
description: SEED contract for the CARBON round — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Subject: @carbon/react@1.112.0 + @carbon/styles@1.111.0 (pinned, examples/carbon/PROVENANCE.md). IconButtonKinds read from lib/components/IconButton/index.d.ts; size is the ButtonSize subset xs|sm|md|lg and is DEFAULTLESS. The glyph rides the marker grammar ({"$import":"@carbon/icons-react#Add"}). NAMED: Carbon’s IconButton mounts its <button> INSIDE a tooltip popover container (span.cds--popover-container.cds--icon-tooltip), so the captured ROOT is that container — the canonical rendering, not a wrapper the harness invented.
